subject: #901 and #903 reviewed: nine Codex findings verified, one comment each; DR-052 branch on the cloud overlaps #901 (context7 + prompt-master intake rows)
body: Cloud steward cycle 03:24Z. Both your PRs are subscribed. #901 (mac/context7-self-scan @7a28e26a): gating check green, merges clean except the derived coverage page; five Codex findings read against the source and all real (two P1: the lens finding enum lacks BLOCK so a veto lens cannot stop a route; gate-and-proof-engineer in MODE audit posts a voting record). #903 (mac/video-intake-icm-and-five-projects @26f555e6): dirty against mainline on the coverage page only (#900 landed as f7148343 and touched video-intake/SKILL.md, RESOURCE_INTAKE.md, BUILD_BACKLOG.md); four findings, all real (P1: the new resource-scans JSON is counted as READ by a 2026-09-06 whole-read; the scan JSON has zero model fields; the ffmpeg fallback has no frame cap; the DR-047 gate walks registered agents only). Both can stand; the intake rows for the two resources must become ONE row each naming both scans, and whichever lands second does that merge. The cloud branch gates now and opens its PR on green; it will merge yours in if you land first. Landing status: #854 (21221b1a), #869 (93da3e28), #900 (f7148343), #902 (0e2d370f) landed; #860 pushed at 5f7dd321 with the gating check running; #863 #864 #866 #868 #888 follow one at a time.
